P.G. Diploma 'Counseling Practitioner Certificate'

Counseling has historically been known as a ‘talking therapy’ that allows an individual to discuss their human experience in a safe and confidential environment. Studying counseling at practitioner level is about embodying the principles that underpin this time-proven method of helping people. Students will develop person-centered counseling skills and gain deep insights into the driving forces that motivate human behavior.

This certified training delves into the heart of traditional person-centered counseling and focuses on facilitating profound personal change at the level of identity beliefs, personal values, and priorities. It includes theoretical frameworks, people skills, and communication patterns that enable significant transformation in counseling clients.

The course is designed to increase self-awareness by analyzing and evaluating the impact of counseling theory and practice on the self and relationships. It is also suitable for those who want to enhance their professional role through counseling skills. The main objective is to provide students with a holistic framework for counseling practice.

Centering on the relational connection between counselor and client, this course combines theoretical understanding with vital communication skills to facilitate lasting transformation. By the end of the course, students will grasp practical ideologies and techniques used by top counseling practitioners to serve themselves and their clients.

Major Highlights of the Course:
  • Learn how to establish relationships using counseling skills
  • Understand how ethical frameworks relate to counseling skills
  • Apply the main ideologies and theoretical approaches in counseling
  • Create a conducive setting for using counseling skills
  • Build structure for successive counseling sessions
  • Conduct counseling sessions effectively
  • Evaluate counseling theory’s impact on self and others
  • Use counseling skills in everyday life and work
  • Influence behavior positively through counseling techniques
  • Improve communication skills for relationships
  • Understand core counseling issues and approaches
  • Reflect on sessions and self-awareness as a counselor
  • Learn to decode verbal and non-verbal communication
Eligibility:
  • Minimum qualification: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology from any recognized university
  • Only for Female Candidates

--- COUNSELING ---

P.G. Diploma 'Counseling Practitioner Certificate'

Counseling has historically been known as a ‘talking therapy’ that allows an individual to discuss their human experience in a safe and confidential environment. Studying counseling at practitioner level is about embodying the principles that underpin this time-proven method of helping people. Students will develop person-centered counseling skills and gain deep insights into the driving forces that motivate human behavior.

This certified training delves into the heart of traditional person-centered counseling and focuses on facilitating profound personal change at the level of identity beliefs, personal values, and priorities. It includes theoretical frameworks, people skills, and communication patterns that enable significant transformation in counseling clients.

The course is designed to increase self-awareness by analyzing and evaluating the impact of counseling theory and practice on the self and relationships. It is also suitable for those who want to enhance their professional role through counseling skills. The main objective is to provide students with a holistic framework for counseling practice.

Centering on the relational connection between counselor and client, this course combines theoretical understanding with vital communication skills to facilitate lasting transformation. By the end of the course, students will grasp practical ideologies and techniques used by top counseling practitioners to serve themselves and their clients.

Major Highlights of the Course:
  • Learn how to establish relationships using counseling skills
  • Understand how ethical frameworks relate to counseling skills
  • Apply the main ideologies and theoretical approaches in counseling
  • Create a conducive setting for using counseling skills
  • Build structure for successive counseling sessions
  • Conduct counseling sessions effectively
  • Evaluate counseling theory’s impact on self and others
  • Use counseling skills in everyday life and work
  • Influence behavior positively through counseling techniques
  • Improve communication skills for relationships
  • Understand core counseling issues and approaches
  • Reflect on sessions and self-awareness as a counselor
  • Learn to decode verbal and non-verbal communication
Eligibility:
  • Minimum qualification: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology from any recognized university
  • Only for Female Candidates
